description: Send a removal request for a listing the user owns or originally submitted. A moderator reviews it; nothing is removed until they accept. Requires the user's confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.

listing.description: A listing the user owns or submitted.

reason.description: Why it should be removed (20+ characters).

name: request_listing_removal
title: Request removal of my listing
